children.nl_statement: Lemma 5.2 (using Lemma 5.1): approximate a log-concave density by normalized exponentials of smooth potentials with positive bounded Hessian, preserving entropy, centered covariance, means and L1 mass.
children.role_in_glue: Supply the sequence to which the smooth estimate applies and the convergence needed in the final limit passage.

notes: Three paper-aligned analytic children, with no sibling proof dependencies. Typed function applications abbreviate formulas inside the closed propositions; beta reduction eliminates them, and no Submission definition occurs. The normalized transport and strict remainder expose the data needed in Section 6. ContDiff uses smooth infinity, not analytic top. Covariance positivity, rigidity weight nonnegativity and the final limit bridge are imported from gate-accepted Submission.Lib.EntropyTools (g00008, x0004). All three interfaces have locally elaborated against exactly Mathlib and ChallengeDeps; sync reported no similar obligations.
